recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It aligns active core examples with the retirement decision while preserving the example's own ValueSet URL, compose, expansion, identifier, and OID registry history.
issue_request: FHIR-40716 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ValueSet. The Vocabulary work group resolved to retire valueset-expansionSource because ValueSet.url should be used instead and the extension did not appear to have current use.
initial_application: Core extension definitions had already been moved out of the R5 source, and the FHIR Extension Pack later changed StructureDefinition-valueset-expansionSource to retired/deprecated with ValueSet.url replacement guidance. Core still had one active ValueSet example instantiating the extension, so the application was incomplete for current core examples.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps ValueSet active and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-examples.xml includes ValueSet/example-expansion as a built example. A 2019 terminology Zulip thread shows longstanding confusion over whether expansionSource duplicated ValueSet.url or represented a literal source URL, and 2024 Vocabulary minutes record FHIR-40716 as resolved at the May WGM. The remaining source/oids.ini entry is a historical canonical/OID mapping rather than an active extension use.
reconciliation: Removed the valueset-expansionSource extension instance and its obsolete explanatory comment from source/valueset/valueset-example-expansion.xml. No Extension Pack files were edited in this core reconciliation because the extension definition there is already retired/deprecated.
source_changes: source/valueset/valueset-example-expansion.xml: removed the valueset-expansionSource extension block from the active prepared-expansion ValueSet example.

related_jiras.note: Separate FHIR-SDC issue surfaced in search that also drops expansionSource from an SDC profile; it is outside FHIR-core and was not decided here.
